name: Climb a Tower
desc:
Welcome to Climb a Tower! 🧗
Can you climb this tower before your energy runs out?

[How to Play]
🔋 Climb the towers wall and make sure your energy doesnt get to low!
💪 Train Energy and Speed to complete the tower faster!
💀 Avoid trolls and scale the tower using your climbing skills!

🖥️ All Devices supported
